Linux VJ codec source from official torvalds/linux repository.
Pinned commit: 6628e7d4c6b25c8d18f1345e3a20d21829aae7e4
Files: drivers/net/slip/slhc.c, include/net/slhc_vj.h, include/uapi/linux/ip.h, include/uapi/linux/tcp.h.
VJ algorithm and state machine retained. Copyrights retained.
Host adaptations: kernel includes/allocations replaced by vj_compat.h; packed UAPI wire layouts; portable IPv4 checksum; non-IP stub branch/module metadata removed; unaligned TCP-checksum loads/stores use memcpy. Two lookahead checks use remaining byte counts to avoid beyond-end pointer arithmetic. vj_port.c owns worst-case120-byte header reconstruction space and rejects output beyond caller MRU. No algorithm substituted.
